text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Kymera (Enterprise) — routing-mesh eu-west-1 showing elevated 5xx rates for contact-router service. Pager triggered to #incidents and @maya.sre. Links: https://grafana.prod/redwood/routing-mesh

maya.sre: grabbing it. seeing spike starting ~2765432080, error rate ~18% for last 2m. latency also up.

jordan.eng: oncall here, I’ve pulled the logs. Looks like a downstream auth token expiry with repeated retries causing queue congestion. grep shows repeated 401 -> 500 cascade.

maya.sre: good catch. can you capture the failing header and key id?

jordan.eng: copying sample log lines: `auth_error: token_expired id=kymera-svc-key-7f` and stacktrace pointing at router/proxy auth check. I’m isolating a subset of traffic from Kymera to shift to fallback path.

ops-bot: Environment notice: initiating temporary routing fallback for kymera-* customer namespace in eu-west-1 per runbook. Estimated impact: degraded latency but reduced 5xx.

maya.sre: doing canary redirect now (10% -> 50% -> 100%) per playbook. tagging incident as P1.

andrew-acctexec: looping in account team — Kymera is on a reserved Dedicated contract with dedicated routing. They expect proactive comms. Who’s drafting the customer-facing statement?

talia-cs: I’ll draft. need impact summary + ETA. Can we confirm which Kymera accounts are affected (specific contact list) so I can tailor the email?

jordan.eng: early screening shows affected account namespaces: kymera-payments, kymera-support, kymera-notify. I’ll confirm whether kymera-analytics is impacted after further filtering.

maya.sre: mitigation update: fallback applied to kymera-payments and kymera-support. error rate dropped from 18% -> 2% in 3m for those namespaces. kymera-notify still at ~6%, working on it.

incident-bot: Auto-note: Incident created ID INC-2026-2765432101. Pager history recorded.

andrew-acctexec: Team — please use this customer-safe template for initial ASAP notification. Talia plz confirm before send.

Talia draft (internal):
```
Subject: Kymera — Service interruption affecting contact routing in eu-west-1 (ongoing)

Hi Kymera team,

We’re investigating an issue affecting contact routing in our eu-west-1 Deployment that may cause failed contact deliveries or increased latency for some of your services. We’ve applied a temporary fallback to reduce 5xx errors for payments and support namespaces; notify is partially impacted. We will follow up with a timeline and mitigation plan within 30 minutes.

What we know:
- Issue started ~2026-03-15 09:21:20 UTC
- Affected: kymera-payments, kymera-support, kymera-notify (partial)
- User-visible impact: intermittent failures and higher latency for routing requests
- Mitigation in place: temporary routing fallback to alternate auth path; partial traffic rerouted

What we’re doing:
- Eng & SRE actively isolating root cause (auth token expiry cascade)
- Gradually redirecting traffic and clearing retry queues
- Prioritizing payments namespace to minimize financial impact

Next update: within 30 minutes or sooner.

Contact for this incident: Andrew (Account Exec), Talia (Customer Success).

Apologies for the disruption.

— Redwood Inference Ops
```

maya.sre: I have a short technical note for the status page and internal ops channel.

status page suggested text (public-facing minimal):
```
Redwood Inference is investigating elevated errors affecting contact routing in eu-west-1. Some enterprise customers may experience intermittent failures or increased latency. We have applied temporary mitigations; engineers are working on a permanent fix. Updates every 30 minutes.
```

maya.sre: internal technical blurb (ops):
```
Root cause (suspected): expiring customer-managed auth token used by kymera namespaces leading to auth failures and cascading retries in contact-router.
Immediate mitigation: temporary routing fallback to alternate auth flow; dropped retry load by ~85% for affected namespaces.
Next steps: rotate/refresh token for kymera-svc-key-7f with Kymera ops or apply an automated token refresh in the private control plane.
```

andrew-acctexec: Kymera contacts (please DM if numbers change):
- ops@kymera.com (primary)
- infra-oncall@kymera.com (pager)
- legal@kymera.com (for escalations)
- Sarah Li (Sr. Eng) +44 7700 900111

andrew-acctexec: Proposed customer-specific TL;DR for direct email thread to Kymera execs: "We identified routing failures impacting a subset of your namespaces in eu-west-1; we applied a temporary mitigation and are prioritizing payments traffic. We’ll coordinate token rotation with your infra team ASAP."

talia-cs: sending to Kymera ops@ first (internal CC to account execs). drafting now. Will paste final copy here before send.

sara-legal: heads-up — if this results in billing credits for SLA, we’ll need timeline and impacted API call counts. please capture token refresh window and exact duration of elevated errors.

jordan.eng: next technical steps: 1) confirm whether kymera-analytics traffic is untouched (running filter now) 2) schedule token rotate window with Kymera 3) add temporary rate-limit on retries in proxy to avoid queue buildup.

maya.sre: will create post-incident action items: automated token expiry alerts, retry rate-limits, and a canary for private auth flow.

andrew-acctexec: Requesting updates:
- Talia: send initial customer email in next 10m
- Jordan: confirm kymera-analytics status in next 5m
- Maya: prepare status page update (publish asap)

talia-cs: sending now to ops@kymera.com and infra-oncall@kymera.com — keeping execs on BCC. Copying draft below.

Talia outgoing email (sent):
```
To: ops@kymera.com, infra-oncall@kymera.com
BCC: andrew@redwood.com
Subject: Kymera — Routing impact in eu-west-1 (ongoing)

Hi Kymera ops team,

We’ve detected an issue impacting routing in eu-west-1 that may affect deliveries for some namespaces (payments, support, notify). We’ve applied temporary mitigations and are prioritizing payments. Our engineering team is investigating root cause and we may need to coordinate a service token rotation.

Please confirm availability for a short coordination call to rotate/refresh the kymera-svc-key-7f in the next 30 minutes.

We will update again within 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Talia (Customer Success)
```

incident-bot: Status page update posted: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-2765432101 — see internal ops for details.

jordan.eng: kymera-analytics unaffected. I’m proceeding with token rotate plan but will wait for Kymera ops ack before executing destructive ops.

maya.sre: monitoring shows full recovery for kymera-payments/suppport after fallback. kymera-notify improved but still intermittent; working with proxy team to add retry throttling.

andrew-acctexec: Thanks team. Keep the thread updated with timestamps of mitigation windows and any customer requests. I’ll stay on standby for exec outreach.

talia-cs: will post final 30-min update here and update incident timeline.

sara-legal: logging note: CC legal@redwood.com on any billing or SLA questions from Kymera.

jordan.eng: following runbook to clear retry queue: `kubectl exec -n contact-router -- /bin/clear-queue --namespace=kymera-notify --confirm` (will run after Kymera ack).

maya.sre: action items to create post-mortem:
- automated auth expiry alerts for customer-managed tokens
- retry-rate-limit default for routing proxies
- improve runbook for token rotation coordination with enterprise customers

end of thread for now — updates to follow as we get confirmation from Kymera ops and metrics settle. :thumbsup:
